item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"piece_id":"03","ready":false,"issues":["Catch-all claim: 03-c1 combines the opt-in status and public-documents scope; split the two Onshape facts.","Catch-all claim: 03-c2 bundles distinct NVIDIA visual, physics, sim-ready, and sequence checks; give each observed check its own narrow claim.","Locator gap: 03-c3’s locators do not support its Slack, Teams, and Outlook detail; cite the exact contiguous passages naming those systems and distinguish the planned feature from deployed behavior.","Unsupported inference: 03-c6 recommends withholding AI from controlled PLM records but cites no Autodesk/PLM evidence and no evidence about controlled records; add a narrowly typed inference with the relevant Autodesk claim or narrow it.","Catch-all synthesis: the staged-adoption path combines Onshape, NVIDIA, Autodesk, and World Labs observations without separately typed, narrowly worded inferences.","Unsupported recommendation: the argument’s human approval for production-record and geometry changes, and its watch list for deployment results and intervention measures, lack dedicated evidence claims.","Transcript verification gap: 03-c5 relies on the podcast transcript’s “one task” figure without audio verification; retain it only as explicitly unverified secondary reporting or verify the audio.","Overstatement risk: describing World Labs’ pending transaction as spatial-model infrastructure consolidation goes beyond the company’s announced agreement; label it as a tentative market inference and preserve the closing conditions."]}
